title: concordance-nf samplesheet schema
description: One row per sequenced library. `subject` carries the identity expectation the pipeline tests: rows sharing a subject must come back identical, rows with different subjects must not.

sample.description: Unique library/run identifier. Must be unique across the sheet.
sample.errorMessage: sample must be unique and contain only A-Z, a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore, dash.

subject.description: The individual this sample is supposed to belong to. Rows sharing a subject must be genotypically identical; rows with different subjects must not be. Use the sample id itself when every row is a distinct individual.

alignment.description: BAM/CRAM preferred. Sketching a jointly called VCF inherits the information sharing joint calling introduces across samples, which inflates apparent concordance.

index.description: Optional. Generated on the fly when omitted, except for BCF, where it is required.

family.description: Optional. Relatedness between different subjects in the same family is expected and not flagged. Defaults to the subject, i.e. every subject is its own family.

sex.description: Optional. Checked against the sex somalier infers from X heterozygosity and Y depth.

batch.description: Optional free-text grouping label, carried through to the report.
